text:
rachel: Quick kickoff  we need a single "roadmap canvas" tying routing tiers to launch gates, migration constraints, and a short sales-facing blurb. Trying to avoid dozens of scattered notes.

diego: Agree. My suggestion: three pragmatic tiers only: cost-optimized shard, geo-guard (residency + soft affinity), and island (dedicated). Keep the surface small.

omar: For each tier we should list: p50/p95/p99 SLOs, allowed egress, KV semantics (local/peeking/none), required contract (if any), and rollback escape hatch. Also note default cost multiplier ranges.

lucy: From customer interviews: residency + p99 predictability are the two top asks. They'll trade throughput for guarantees if we show clear numbers. Sales will want a demo toggle and concrete % ranges.

diego: Operational nuance: cross-region KV peeking improves cold-starts but raises egress and can spike p99 under bad links. If we support peeking for geo-guard, it must be opt-in with documented p99 delta and cost multiplier. Default = no peeking.

rachel: Proposed launch criteria (v1): 1) tiny policy DSL + lint, 2) telemetry widgets + alert thresholds, 3) migration playbook with pilot tenants (3-7) + soft-evict <2hr, 4) finance-approved cost multipliers, 5) legal/regulatory sign-off for residency lanes.

omar: Add mandatory chaos sims for any tier that allows peeking: slow-link & partial region outage. Rollback path must route to a compatible regional variant in <=30 min. Tenant-island requires Reserved Capacity before cutover.

lucy: Sales copy idea: single toggle "Isolation: Standard / Strong" with tooltip: "Strong: dedicated or isolated compute + residency. Typical uplift: +30% to +120% depending on throughput and model class." That gives SDRs something to work with.

diego: Also include a tiny policy example for the one-pager so engineering can validate quickly. Keep it purposely minimal. Eg:

```
policy: { tier: "geo-guard", affinity: "soft", kv: "region-local", peeking: "opt-in", fallback: "region-compat-quant", sla_p99_ms: 120 }
```

rachel: I'll draft the canvas: tier table, launch gates checklist, example DSL, migration stub, and a one-paragraph sales blurb with sample multipliers. Target EOD Friday.

omar: I'll author the migration/playbook template and chaos checklist. Will include a simple rollback runbook that ops can execute.

lucy: I'll draft the demo toggle copy and a short FAQ for SDRs (what to promise, what not to promise). Include sample contract language: "tenant-island activation requires reserved-capacity agreement."

ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy-canary v7 deployed to canary-55 (link: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/canary-55).

diego: Small ask: keep defaults conservative and visible in the canvas (no peeking, region-local by default). We can add opt-in capabilities later.

rachel: Agreed. Minimal v1 surface reduces operational surprises. Reconvene next Wed 10am to finalize.
